name: Word Counter
description: Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in real time, with estimated reading and speaking time.

faq.question: Does this word counter send my text anywhere?
faq.answer: No. Everything is counted locally in your browser using JavaScript — your text is never uploaded or transmitted, even while you're typing.

faq.question: How is reading time calculated?
faq.answer: Reading time is estimated at 200 words per minute, a commonly used average adult silent-reading speed. Speaking time is estimated at 130 words per minute.

faq.question: How are sentences counted?
faq.answer: A sentence is counted at each run of '.', '!', or '?' that ends a chunk of text, so abbreviations followed by more text in the same sentence can occasionally be over-counted — treat the sentence count as a close estimate rather than an exact grammatical parse.

faq.question: What counts as a paragraph?
faq.answer: Any block of text separated by one or more blank lines counts as one paragraph.
